boundaries: This is an isolated text-only llama.cpp process using the existing qwen3.8 GGUF language-model blob; its vision projector is not loaded.
A roughly 512-token input and short completion are tested at context 8192, concurrency 1; this does not establish full-capacity context performance, concurrent throughput or domain answer quality.
The original Ollama service, existing other-project containers, project database configuration and global security configuration are not changed.
